fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-04-07 states that the complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 8,500) after boarding a crowded bus near Mullai Colony Shopping Complex, on 2026-04-05 at about 18:25. Yogesh Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000359. A person named Sanjay Palanisamy, associated with the number 9000000215, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. A further person, Abirami Rani, a driver, using the number 9000000451, is stated to be associated with the incident. Ramya Bai (9000000232) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The incident reportedly occurred on or near a bus bearing registration TN-58-ZZ-1035. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue. The incident reportedly took place on a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, mobile number, bus, CCTV, shopping complex, witness, suspect
